about: ADR-0246 section 4 / ADR-0237 (amended non-goal): the named looks bundled with the app, offered by Settings > Look > Screen. Every file in this folder is listed here with its source, license and sha256; UI.Tests/Config/NamedLookManifestTests checks the bytes against these hashes. Adding a look is a code change.
